title: Audio frame header compatibility predicate
summary: Recovered the pure two-scalar ECX/EDX fastcall predicate at VA 0x58f460. Requires equality under mask 0xfffe0c00 and agreement on channel mode being 3. Returns exactly 0 or 1 without memory accesses. Direct caller 0x590197 follows a separate validity predicate; compatibility itself accepts invalid headers too.
test_description: Direct accepted-original comparisons: zero/all-one and representative MPEG headers, each differing bit in both directions on two backgrounds, all 8192 ignored-bit combinations across all 16 channel-mode pairs, each equality-mask bit broken across all modes, and 100000 pseudorandom raw and mask-matched pairs. Assert exact 0/1 results, explicit expected mode and rejection outcomes, and unchanged input/sentinel storage. Original disassembly establishes absence of memory side effects.
known_limits: No byte-matching claim; portable scalar logic with x86 fastcall declaration.
Only this compatibility predicate is recovered; frame parsing and independent header validity are outside scope.
Caller inspection covers the direct call found in executable disassembly; indirect uses are not established.
